item.title: Falcons rookie Pearce arrested after what police said was a domestic dispute with WNBA player
item.description: Atlanta Falcons rookie star James Pearce Jr. was arrested near Miami on Saturday night after fleeing officers and then crashing his car following what police said was a domestic dispute with WNBA player Rickea Jackson.

item.title: Duke's Scheyer says staff members 'got punched in the face' during court-storming; UNC AD apologizes
item.description: Duke coach Jon Scheyer said he had staff members "that got punched in the face" as North Carolina fans stormed the court to celebrate a late winning shot in the famed rivalry Saturday night.

item.title: Nikola Jokic passes Oscar Robertson for 2nd-most triple-doubles as Nuggets top Bulls 136-120
item.description: Nikola Jokic had 22 points, 17 assists and 14 rebounds to pass Oscar Robertson for the second-most triple-doubles in NBA history and the Denver Nuggets ended a three-game skid with a 136-120 victory over the Chicago Bulls.

item.title: No. 17 Florida beats Texas A&M 86-67 in showdown for Southeastern Conference lead
item.description: Thomas Haugh scored 22 points and No. 17 Florida beat Texas A&M 86-67 on Saturday night in a showdown for the Southeastern Conference lead.

item.title: Jeremy Fears' 26 points and 15 assists help No. 10 Michigan State beat No. 5 Illinois 85-82 in OT
item.description: Jeremy Fears scored 26 points, including a tiebreaking three-point play with 1:47 left in overtime, and had 15 assists to help No. 10 Michigan State hold on for an 85-82 win over No. 5 Illinois.

item.title: LeBron James has 20 points, 10 assists to lead Luka-less Lakers past Warriors
item.description: LeBron James had 20 points, 10 assists and seven rebounds to help the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Golden State Warriors 105-99 on Saturday night.

item.title: Otega Oweh scores 21, Kentucky beats No. 25 Tennessee 74-71
item.description: Otega Oweh scored 21 points to lead Kentucky to a 74-71 win over No. 25 Tennessee.

item.title: Embiid scores 33, Maxey adds 29 and the 76ers beat the Suns 109-103 for 6th win in 7 games
item.description: Joel Embiid scored 33 points, Tyrese Maxey added 29 and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the cold-shooting Phoenix Suns 109-103 on Saturday night.

item.title: Rockets' Alperen Sengun apologizes publicly for directing gender-based insult at female official
item.description: Houston Rockets center Alperen Sengun publicly apologized for directing a gender-based insult at official Jenna Reneau during a loss Wednesday night to Boston Celtics.
